title: /about in English, /cs/about in Czech
lead: The default locale owns the bare path and the others carry a prefix. Fully prerendered on adapter-static, with a fallback shell so an unknown URL still gets a translated page.

optional.title: An optional segment
optional.text: [[lang=locale]] matches nothing at all for English. The matcher accepts only the prefixed locales, or it would swallow /about.

fallback.title: A fallback shell
fallback.text: fallback: '404.html' writes one shell that the host serves for every unknown URL. That shell is what makes the error page yours.

error.title: The error page has no load
error.text: It reads the instance from context, and its strings ship in config.translations — nothing behind a loader is guaranteed to be there.

note.title: Try it
note.text: Open /cs/nope on the built site. The 404 arrives in Czech on the first hit, not after a reload.
